name: ottie
description: Local-first IM client where AI agents are first-class members
author: TODO

scripts.build:daemon: pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight build && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay build && pnpm --filter @ottie/server build && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli build
scripts.typecheck:daemon: pnpm --filter @ottie/relay typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli typecheck
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run version:sync-internal && pnpm --filter @ottie/app build:web && pnpm --filter @ottie/desktop build
scripts.version: pnpm run version:sync-internal && pnpm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: pnpm run release:prepare && pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight build && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay build && pnpm --filter @ottie/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/server build && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli build && pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @ottie/server pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli pack --dry-run
scripts.release:publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight publish --dry-run --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay publish --dry-run --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/server publish --dry-run --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli publish --dry-run --access public
scripts.release:publish: pnpm --filter @ottie/highlight publish --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/relay publish --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/server publish --access public && pnpm --filter @ottie/cli publish --access public
scripts.release:beta:patch: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:patch && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:minor: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:minor && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:major: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:major && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:next: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:next && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:promote && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:patch && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:minor && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:major: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:major && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
